thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — preparing the release notes for the docs site rollout tomorrow (v0.9.4). Need to coordinate: PRs for SDK snippets, migration guide tweak, and a couple of link fixes. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4582

dan: Thanks — can you paste the known-issues block here? I want to flag anything blocking the publish.

maya: Known issues summary (short):
- Embeddings streaming deprecated: examples still show old API (needs removal).
- Python SDK sample uses old client instantiation for auth.
- Internal anchor links broke on Deploy flow page when we moved headings.

alex: I can take the embeddings examples. I'll open a tiny PR to replace the streaming example with the new embed streaming migration snippet. ETA 2h. :+1:

sam: I'll fix the Python SDK snippet and add a tiny test harness snippet. Filing PR now -> #4591.

lee: I'll comb anchor links after alex's change; can we put a quick link-check step in the relnotes job? docs-bot, any existing check we can reuse?

docs-bot: auto-check: anchor-checker job exists but currently only runs on main. Recommend adding it to the relnotes branch CI (see .github/workflows/link-check.yml).

maya: Good call. Lee, can you add the job to the relnotes workflow? If it's a minor PR I can merge before the publish.

lee: Yep. I will:
- Add anchor-checker step to .github/workflows/release-notes.yml
- Run locally against the branch and post results here
ETA: 1h.

dan: Two small editorial asks: 1) add a one-line callout about Dedicated capacity improvements, and 2) a short note about the latency SLO change (non-breaking). Those are marketing-safe lines, I'll draft and post.

maya: For the changelog bullets, please keep them tight — one sentence each + link to the feature docs. Dan, draft and ping me for copy edit.

sam: PR #4591 created for python snippet fix. I added a test snippet in examples/python/snippets/reinit_auth.md. CI passed locally.

alex: PR #4589 opened replacing embed streaming example and adding migration note. I left a TODO to remove the old reference in quickstart.md — can we just delete that line?

maya: Delete it, yes. But add a short replacement paragraph pointing to the migration guide. We want users to see the recommended path.

lee: Link-check run (local) -> found 3 broken anchors in deploy/flow.md: #deploy-options, #regional-routing, #legacy-flag. All from the heading rename. I'll push fixes in #4595.

docs-bot: note: release-notes draft PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4582 — now includes known-issues section and draft bullets. CI: pending.

dan: Copy draft posted: "Dedicated: added CPU+GPU mix for burst pools — see /docs/dedicated/bursting. Latency SLO: improved median latency; no customer API changes." Maya, edits?

maya: Slight tweak: "Dedicated: burst pools now support mixed CPU/GPU allocation for better cost predictability. See /docs/dedicated/bursting." LGTM.

sam: Quick question re: deploy timing — do we want to gate the doc publish on the SDK patch release? The python snippet depends on a minor SDK fix scheduled for tonight.

maya: We have two options: 1) ship docs now with a small 'works with SDK >= X.Y.Z' callout in the snippet, or 2) hold docs until SDK release. I'd prefer option 1 with a clear compatibility note. Less churn.

dan: Agree. Add the compatibility banner above the snippet: "Requires SDK >= 0.6.2 (patch releasing 2024-05-14)."

lee: I've pushed #4595 with link fixes and added the anchor-checker step to the relnotes workflow. docs-bot, running CI now.

docs-bot: CI started for PRs: #4582 (release notes), #4589 (embed migration), #4591 (python snippet), #4595 (link fixes). All queued.

alex: One more thing — migration guide needs a short code diff example showing old->new call shape for embeddings. I can add a 3-line snippet.

maya: Perfect. Can everyone add a one-line PR description like "docs: fix X" so changelog generator picks it up.

sam: Done. #4591 description is "docs: fix python auth snippet".

lee: Link-check CI green on #4595. Nothing else failing so far.

dan: Final check: Maya, can you sign off on the release notes copy by EOD? I can schedule the publish for 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

maya: Yes — I'll do a final pass after CI finishes. If anything blocks, we'll do a patch release in the morning. Thanks all. :rocket:

docs-bot: reminder: schedule release job with tag v0.9.4 once PR #4582 is merged. Use workflow: .github/workflows/publish-docs.yml"
